feature.level_2: Model Policies and Weights (SFT / LoRA / DPO / GRPO / Agent RL)
feature.description: Learns stronger planning, tool use, and evaluation behavior. Validate with holdout benchmarks, robustness tests, and regressions.

contract.purpose_user_function: Train or adapt model policies/weights for planning, tool use, or evaluation, then gate them on holdout and robustness evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Training dataset, base model/checkpoint, method/config, compute environment, reward/preferences, holdout benchmarks, safety policy, and budget.
contract.expected_outputs: Versioned checkpoint/adapter, training manifest/logs, benchmark/robustness/regression report, and promotion decision.
contract.state_side_effects: Would create large model/checkpoint artifacts and consume accelerator resources.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing data/model/license, unsupported hardware, training failure, unsafe behavior, contamination, holdout regression, or approval denial blocks promotion.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Not found in current codebase: no general SFT, LoRA, DPO, GRPO, or agent-RL training pipeline is shipped.
contract.success_evidence: Would require reproducible training manifest/checkpoint plus independent holdout, safety, and regression evidence; no current proof exists.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: dataset/license; train smoke; checkpoint integrity; holdout; robustness; safety; regression; promote/rollback.
